First public Windows beta.

offveil is a small app you install on the PC. One switch, no VPN, no account. It is for Discord and similar services that ISPs in Turkiye interfere with.

Download `offveil_*_x64-setup.exe` from Assets. The installer asks for permission once and puts the app in `C:\Program Files\offveil`.

If Windows shows **Windows protected your PC**, click More info, then Run anyway.

If it does not work: Settings → Save a support file, and send that file with your report.
